font-size-2xs.$description: 16px base — CJK body text standard 12px — micro labels

radius-sharp.$description: deliberate zero radius — typographic / tool UI

radius-box.$description: 4-tier semantic radius (inspired by DaisyUI) Card, Modal, Panel

color-fg-secondary.$description: NOTE: fg-secondary (zinc-500) is intentionally lighter than fg-muted (zinc-600). fg-secondary = supplementary text (timestamps, metadata) — lower emphasis. fg-muted = de-emphasized but still readable body text — mid emphasis. This follows the pattern: fg > fg-muted > fg-secondary > fg-tertiary.

color-fg-tertiary.$description: text: 4.8:1 on white (WCAG AA). zinc-400 is decorative only

color-fg-decorative.$description: icons, markers, separators: no text here

chart-1.$description: Series order for charts. Every colour keeps 3:1 against both the light surface and the dark surface (WCAG 1.4.11). The order is chosen so that the first colours stay apart under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia as well as normal vision: the closest pair among the first 4 is CIEDE2000 12.2, first 6 is 7.4, first 8 is 5.2. Prefer six series or fewer. The named --chart-<hue> colours are unchanged.

font-sans.$description: Body: Japanese-first stack. Latin glyphs fall through to Noto's own Latin, so numbers and ASCII share x-height and weight with the kana.

font-display.$value:
var(--font-montserrat, "Montserrat"), var(--font-noto-sans-jp, "Noto Sans JP"), -apple-system,
    "Hiragino Sans", Meiryo, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Display: headings and large numerals. Montserrat for Latin, Noto for kana.

font-feature-display.$description: Proportional kana (palt) is applied to display text only. On body copy it tightens punctuation and hurts readability.

measure-ja.$description: max line length for Japanese prose (about 40 characters)

color-focus.$description: Solid foreground colour so the ring passes WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on every theme. A translucent grey ring measured 1.5:1 and was effectively invisible.

jp.kaze.section: Density (component sizing — orthogonal to color theme)
jp.kaze.sectionNote: Two-stage system: normal values here, [data-density="compact"] overrides below. Attach the attribute to :root or any container; custom properties inherit down the subtree either way. Every normal value below equals the literal it replaces, so the default appearance does not change when this section is added.
